comment: Shared contract cases for the companion protocol: the Swift host (LiloTests/Companion/CompanionHostTests.swift) and the TypeScript schema (companion-extension/src/protocol.test.ts) must accept and reject the same messages with the same words. A case with an "error" is a rejection with that exact message; a case without one is accepted.
